note: Official public GIS overlays for GlobeDesk. Live GIS is off by default and only the user can opt in. OpenHistoricalMap stays unknown, with no URL, until a style and date filter are deliberately connected. Do not invent endpoints. A down host is a skip, not a replacement dataset. Online geocoding stays off. Census geocoding is not a registry host.

layers.label: USGS Topo (current The National Map, not year-stamped)
layers.credit: USGS The National Map: National Boundaries Dataset, 3DEP Elevation Program, Geographic Names Information System, National Hydrography Dataset, National Land Cover Database, National Structures Dataset, and National Transportation Dataset; USGS Global Ecosystems; U.S. Census Bureau TIGER/Line; USFS Road Data; Natural Earth Data; U.S. Department of State HIU; NOAA NCEI. Data refreshed September 4, 2026.
layers.terms: Current official USGS composite, not a yearly time dimension. Do not label a historical data-year view of this layer as recorded for that year. Attribution required.

layers.label: USGS Imagery Only (current ortho, not year-stamped)
layers.credit: USDA, USGS The National Map: Orthoimagery. Data refreshed June, 2024.
layers.terms: Current official ortho mosaic, not a dated yearly stack. Do not label a historical data-year view as recorded ortho for that year.

layers.label: USGS National Hydrography Dataset (current)
layers.credit: USGS TNM – National Hydrography Dataset. Data Refreshed October, 2026.
layers.terms: Current official hydrography, not year-stamped. Raster export only; no attribute query for personal fields. A down host is skipped.

layers.label: Census TIGERweb state and county boundaries
layers.terms: Official TIGERweb boundaries. Legal boundaries are never projected. Years without a vintage stay off or show the nearest vintage labelled as not that year. No ACS2020 service.

layers.label: NOAA nowCOAST base reflectivity (current observations)
layers.credit: NOAA nowCOAST / NWS. Current weather observations, not historical.
layers.terms: Current observations only. Hidden for a historical data year. A down host is skipped.

layers.label: USGS Mineral Resources Data System (MRDS): mineral deposits (live)
layers.credit: U.S. Geological Survey, Mineral Resources Data System (MRDS). Live map service. USGS: "As of 2011, USGS has ceased systematic updates to MRDS."
layers.terms: USGS metadata: "Access_Constraints: none" and "Use_Constraints: none"; WMS capabilities: Fees none, AccessConstraints none. Shown live from mrdata.usgs.gov only, never cached or bundled. A down or blocked host is shown as unavailable and skipped.
